item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 21/Oct/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The intense northeast monsoon will continue to affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be persistently windy and cooler over the region. Meanwhile, Tropical Cyclone Fengshen will move towards the central part of Vietnam and weaken progressively. With Fengshen departing and the monsoon moderating slightly, the weather over Guangdong will become brighter in the latter part of this week. Daytime temperatures will rise gradually. A replenishment of the monsoon is expected to affect southern China early next week. There will be sunny intervals over the region and dry during the day.
